notes: Checkpoint uses current_run_started_at (not completion time) per spec; tmp file + os.replace atomic write. Monday-sweep lesson learned: the arXiv API (export.arxiv.org) rate-limits hard after a few paged queries and stays blocked for >30min — /list/<cat>/recent?skip=N&show=250 pagination covers the last 5 announcement days reliably and was the working fallback (show must be one of 25/50/100/250/500/1000/2000). Digest-day headers in /recent map directly to announcement dates for published_at attribution. Current watermark: 2609.04199 (Fri 4 Sep digest, complete at retrieval; cross-lists may still arrive). HF counters rolled a third consecutive cycle; downloads are 30d-window (young repo ~= all-time), likes are the finer signal. openai.com returns 403 to WebFetch — use the web_reader MCP for openai.com pages, and verify numbers against page text (secondary media added claims like 'opaque recurrence'/context-window sizes that the launch page does not state — excluded from the event). AA model pages (artificialanalysis.ai/models/<id>) are a reliable primary for index scores/cost-per-task. cursor.com/changelog and research.meta.ai read fine via WebFetch; x.ai/news gives a dated archive.
